name: Colorado
short: Xcel Energy pays $750 per heating ton for a cold-climate heat pump, and $1,500 per ton for homes heated with Xcel gas from October 1, 2026, which we could not yet confirm is live. A heat pump water heater gets $750 or $1,500, a smart thermostat $50 and a home EV charger up to $500. Colorado Springs Utilities pays $1,500 to $3,000 for a heat pump, and Fort Collins Utilities pays $500 per ton up to $3,000. Solar has no upfront rebate for most homes in 2026, and the federal credits ended after 2025.
